title: A 1.116.0 install does not ask to update on this repo's stub: how should item 6 end?
context: Item 6 is done only if a 1.116.0 install on this repo asks to update, and the spec sends a failure here to the owner. I installed the published 1.116.0 in a throwaway folder with a separate HOME and ran it against the stub with minimum_version=1.117.0. It asks nothing. Because the stub also says paqad_enable=false, every 1.116.0 hook stands down silently: silent-update exits before it reads the minimum version, no npm call runs, and the session start and prompt hooks print nothing. Only paqad-ai doctor says paqad is disabled and suggests paqad-ai enable, which is not an update. With the off switch set to true, the same 1.116.0 starts a forced-minimum update to 1.118.0, so the minimum version works only when paqad is on. The stub's comment, written by stubText, also claims an older paqad asks to update, and that wording is wrong for 1.116.0. Items 1 to 5 are committed, and the one-line stub edit is uncommitted.
